item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 23/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will continue to bring very hot weather to the coast of Guangdong today. A trough of low pressure will move across the coast of southern China tonight to tomorrow. There will be a few showers over the region. Under the influence of a drier easterly airstream, temperatures will fall slightly over the coast of Guangdong early next week. Another trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers and thunderstorms to southern China midweek next week.
